narrative.headline: 2018 Toyota Camry: power train leads the owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 722 complaints with NHTSA. The power train is the most reported area at 26%, followed closely by the brakes (23%) and the engine (18%). No deaths are reported. The brakes stand out for severity, tied to 21 crashes and 22 injuries, by far the most of any area, so they are worth a careful look on a test drive.
